final: SELECT SUM(step1.cnt) as total_counts, AVG(step1.cnt - step2.avg_cnt) as avg_diff FROM (SELECT film.rating, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM inventory JOIN film ON inventory.film_id = film.film_id GROUP BY film.rating) step1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM (SELECT film.rating, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM inventory JOIN film ON inventory.film_id = film.film_id GROUP BY film.rating)) step2 WHERE step1.cnt > step2.avg_cnt
